descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed. This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING! This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization. Key
• Responsibilities Set up and operate machinery according to instructions. Monitor machine performance and make minor adjustments. Inspect products for quality and report defects. Maintain a clean and safe work area. Record production data and report issues. Follow safety and operational procedures. Skills &
• Qualifications May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role. Basic mechanical skills and attention to detail. Ability to follow instructions and safety guidelines. Good hand-eye coordination and physical stamina. Willingness to learn and work in a team environment. Familiarity with production tools and equipment is a plus. What we offer you Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
